def fresh_local(mode):
    command="""Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe' OR Name='ssh.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'run_teacher159_secure|run_teacher150_secure|run_teacher140_secure|collect_TWO134|collect_E3_source210_TERMINAL' } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,CreationDate,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress"""
    q=subprocess.run(['pwsh.exe','-NoProfile','-Command',command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf8',check=True)
    rows=json.loads(q.stdout) if q.stdout.strip() else [];rows=rows if isinstance(rows,list) else [rows]
    active=[x for x in rows if x['ProcessId']!=os.getpid()]
    report=dict(epoch=time.time(),mode=mode,self_PID=os.getpid(),self_executable=sys.executable,self_argv=sys.argv,matched_known_own_finite_identities=rows,other_matching_own_finites=active)
    put('FRESH_LOCAL_EXACT_CIM_'+mode.upper()+'_ACTUAL.json',report)
    assert not active,'another known own finite is alive; do not open a second SSH channel'
    return report
